pairs: Et regnavit rex Sedecias filius Josiæ pro Jechonia filio Joakim, quem constituit regem Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis in terra Juda:
And then king Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, reigned in place of Jeconiah, the son of Jehoiakim. For Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, appointed him as king in the land of Judah.
nor the people of the land,
obeyed the words of the Lord,
quæ locutus est in manu Jeremiæ prophetæ.
which he spoke by the hand of Jeremiah, the prophet.
Et misit rex Sedecias Juchal filium Selemiæ,
And king Zedekiah sent Jehucal, the son of Shelemiah,
and Zephaniah, the son of Maaseiah,
Ora pro nobis Dominum Deum nostrum.
“Pray to the Lord our God for us.”
Jeremias autem libere ambulabat in medio populi:
Now Jeremiah was walking freely in the midst of the people.
non enim miserant eum in custodiam carceris.
For they had not yet sent him into the custody of the prison.
Igitur exercitus Pharaonis egressus est de Ægypto,
And then the army of Pharaoh went forth from Egypt.
et audientes Chaldæi qui obsidebant Jerusalem,
Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam prophetam,
And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet,
“Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel:
Sic dicetis regi Juda, qui misit vos ad me interrogandum:
So shall you say to the king of Judah, who sent you to question me:
qui egressus est vobis in auxilium,
which has gone forth in assistance to you,
revertetur in terram suam in Ægyptum:
will return to their own land, into Egypt.
and will make war against this city.
Do not be willing to deceive your own souls,
For they will not go away.
Sed etsi percusseritis omnem exercitum Chaldæorum qui præliantur adversum vos,
But even if you were to strike down the entire army of the Chaldeans who are fighting against you,
et derelicti fuerint ex eis aliqui vulnerati,
and if there were left behind from among them only a few wounded men,
they would rise up, each one from his tent,
and they would burn this city with fire.”
Ergo cum recessisset exercitus Chaldæorum ab Jerusalem,
when the army of the Chaldeans had withdrawn from Jerusalem because of Pharaoh’s army,
egressus est Jeremias de Jerusalem ut iret in terram Benjamin,
Jeremiah went forth from Jerusalem, to go into the land of Benjamin,
et divideret ibi possessionem in conspectu civium.
and to distribute a possession there, in the sight of the citizens.
And when he had arrived at the gate of Benjamin,
erat ibi custos portæ per vices,
the keeper of the gate, whose turn it was to be there,
nomine Jerias filius Selemiæ filii Hananiæ:
was named Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah.
And he apprehended Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
I am not fleeing to the Chaldeans.”
But he did not listen to him.
and he brought him to the leaders.
quam ob rem irati principes contra Jeremiam,
Therefore, the leaders were angry with Jeremiah,
cæsum eum miserunt in carcerem qui erat in domo Jonathan scribæ:
and so they beat him and sent him to the prison that was in the house of Jonathan,
ipse enim præpositus erat super carcerem.
the scribe. For he was the chief over the prison.
Itaque ingressus est Jeremias in domum laci et in ergastulum:
And so Jeremiah went into the house of the prison and into a dungeon.
et sedit ibi Jeremias diebus multis.
And Jeremiah sat there for many days.
et interrogavit eum in domo sua abscondite,
took him out and questioned him secretly in his house,
“Do you think that there is any word from the Lord?”
“You will be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon.”
Et dixit Jeremias ad regem Sedeciam:
And Jeremiah said to king Zedekiah:
quia misisti me in domum carceris?
such that you would cast me into a house of imprisonment?
Non veniet rex Babylonis super vos,
‘The king of Babylon will not overwhelm you
valeat deprecatio mea in conspectu tuo, et ne me remittas in domum Jonathan scribæ,
Let my petition prevail in your sight. And do not send me back into the house of Jonathan the scribe,
Præcepit ergo rex Sedecias ut traderetur Jeremias in vestibulo carceris,
Then king Zedekiah instructed that Jeremiah be confined to the vestibule of the prison,
et daretur ei torta panis quotidie,
and that they should give him a twist of bread daily,
donec consumerentur omnes panes de civitate:
until all the bread in the city had been consumed.
et mansit Jeremias in vestibulo carceris.
And Jeremiah remained at the entrance of the prison.
